={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "o4-mini", messages: [{ role: "system", content: "You are a building behavior analysis specialist.
Return a single valid JSON object only — no markdown, no code fences, no explanation.
The JSON must have exactly these top-level keys: study_id, output_mode, dashboard_summary, insights, recommendations.

Do NOT include charts or tables — these are handled separately in code.

insights must be a plain array of strings. Each insight is a single string sentence.
recommendations must be a plain array of strings. Each recommendation is a single string sentence.

STUDY DURATION & CONFIDENCE:
- The input includes a data_context object with duration_seconds, duration_label, detection_count, and sampling_note.
- Calibrate confidence of insights and recommendations accordingly. Only mention duration when directly relevant to a specific claim." }, { role: "user", content: JSON.stringify({ study_id: $json.study_id, output_mode: $json.output_mode, study_plan: $json.study_plan, instructions: $json.instructions, data_context: $json.data_context, detection_summary: $json.detection_summary }, null, 2) }] }) }}

No charts, no tables. insights and recommendations must be plain arrays of strings. Use the study_id provided, never invent a default. No markdown, no code fences." }, { role: "user", content: JSON.stringify({ study_id: $('Fetch Study Data from Supabase').item.json.study_id, output_mode: $('Fetch Study Data from Supabase').item.json.output_mode, raw_ai_output: $json.raw_ai_output, validation_errors: $json.validation_errors }, null, 2) }], temperature: 0 }) }}
